title: Tolle: The Astonishing Power of 'Yes' (Video)
excerpt: Align with the present moment, and you will find that space.

inline.s: The ego: it reacts and seeks identification.
Align with the present moment, and you will find that space.

When you truly realize that a flower exists in complete stillness, the stillness is not only within it — you can almost feel the field of stillness surrounding it. All things in nature are like this, and it is so beautiful. It is alive, yet it has no noise. So, to notice that dimension is to notice the spaciousness that surrounds the content of your life — that field of stillness, that space.

I have only given the example of a flower, but this applies to all the content of your life. For instance, with the annoying event of a 'traffic jam,' you can also notice that it is surrounded by the same field of stillness, that space, for that space is always present in the present moment where every event occurs.

How do you find the space around that event? Simply allow that moment to be as it is. When you say a complete 'Yes!' to whatever is happening, instead of fighting and resisting it, you will discover that space.
